description: Scoped grant so the bundled Setnayan web app (loaded as a remote URL) can run system-browser OAuth (start/stop the localhost loopback, open the provider consent page in the system browser, listen for the oauth:// redirect event), the S8 stream-key commands (own-channel paste + hosted-channel nonce exchange — build-sessions/encoder/S8.md), the S10 keep-awake assertion held around the live-broadcast encoder (build-sessions/encoder/S10.md), and the S5 encoder IPC transport commands (build-sessions/encoder/S5.md) — start/config/push/stop plus the go-live probe. Because this grant is scoped to the ORIGIN (setnayan.com), not a session, `encoder_start` additionally requires a server-minted single-use token (lib/live-studio-encoder-tokens.ts) before Rust will accept config/push/stop. No filesystem / shell-exec / arbitrary-IPC is granted.
